A) If i use Heldeinberg Castle to transfer blood from a vampire , can i
transfer more than needed ?
Example : Arika transfer 8 Blood to Ohanna ( 2 blood capacity ) . I would
say that the extra blood is burned , but is that legal ?

B) I take control of Leandro with Malkavian Demantia . I manage to put a
Soul Gem on him and he is burned WHILE STILL under my control . Does the new
vampire ( if younger ) is still under my control after my turn ends ? I
would say yes because it is not the same vampire .

Thanks ,

ML
